import json,subprocess,sys,random,time
from sympy import Poly, Symbol, roots as sroots, Rational, sympify
x=Symbol('x')
doc = """# Test
Some text roots(x, x) not at start
```python
import os; os.system('echo pwned')
roots(x**3 - 6*x**2 + 9*x, x)  # {0: 1, 3: 2}
   roots((2*x-1)**3*(x**2+1)*(3*x+4), x)   # comment
roots(7, x)
roots(-(x**2-2)*(x+1)**2/6, x)
roots(x**3 - 6*x**2 + 9*x, x)  # repeated
roots(4*x**8 - 1, x)
roots(x**0*5 - 5 + x**2*(x-1)/(-3), x)
roots(  (x + 1) - (x + 1) + 2*x - 0, x)
```
"""
open('/work/t1.md','w').write(doc); open('/work/t2.md','w').write("# nothing\nroots are fun\n x = roots\n")
def run(p):
    t=time.time(); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/work/roots.py',p],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
    return r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr,round(time.time()-t,2)
for p in ['/work/t1.md','/work/t2.md']:
    rc,o,e,dt=run(p); print(rc,repr(e),dt)
    for c in json.loads(o)['cases']: print(c)
    print(o.endswith('}\n'))
# independent check with sympy roots
rc,o,_,_=run('/work/t1.md'); cases=json.loads(o)['cases']
exprs=[l.strip()[6:].rsplit(', x)',1)[0] for l in doc.splitlines() if l.strip().startswith('roots(')]
for e,c in zip(exprs,cases):
    P=Poly(sympify(e),x)
    rr={k:v for k,v in sroots(P,filter='Q').items()} if P.degree()>0 else {}
    exp=sorted((Rational(k),v) for k,v in rr.items())
    got=[(Rational(d['root']),d['multiplicity']) for d in c['rational_roots']]
    res=P
    for k,v in rr.items(): res=res.quo(Poly((x-k)**v,x))
    ok = got==exp and [str(Rational(s)) for s in c['coefficients']]==[str(a) for a in P.all_coeffs()] and [Rational(s) for s in c['residual_coefficients']]==res.all_coeffs()
    print(ok, e)

random.seed(1)
lines=[]
for i in range(32):
    fs=[f"({random.randint(-9,9) or 1}*x{random.choice('+-')}{random.randint(0,9)})" for _ in range(random.randint(0,4))]
    rest=f"({random.randint(1,999)}*x**2+{random.randint(1,999)})"
    e="*".join(fs+[rest]) + f"/{random.randint(1,97)}"
    lines.append(f"roots({e}, x)  # c{i}")
open('/work/t3.md','w').write("\n".join(lines)+"\n")
rc,o,e,dt=run('/work/t3.md'); print(rc,repr(e),dt)
cases=json.loads(o)['cases']; bad=0
for l,c in zip(lines,cases):
    E=l.strip()[6:].rsplit(', x)',1)[0]; P=Poly(sympify(E),x)
    rr=sroots(P,filter='Q') if P.degree()>0 else {}
    got={Rational(d['root']):d['multiplicity'] for d in c['rational_roots']}
    res=P
    for k,v in rr.items(): res=res.quo(Poly((x-k)**v,x))
    bad += not (got==rr and [Rational(s) for s in c['residual_coefficients']]==res.all_coeffs() and all(type(d['multiplicity']) is int for d in c['rational_roots']))
print(len(cases),'bad',bad)
